name: ecommerce-monorepo
description: E-commerce platform with Angular frontend and Nginx backend

scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:backend: cd adminbucket/nginx-1.4.1 && npm run test:nginx || echo 'No backend tests configured'
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:frontend && npm run test:coverage:backend && node coverage-merge.js
scripts.test:coverage:backend: cd adminbucket/nginx-1.4.1 && npm run test:coverage:nginx || echo 'No backend coverage configured'
scripts.lint:backend: cd adminbucket/nginx-1.4.1 && npm run lint:nginx || echo 'No backend linting configured'
scripts.lint:fix: cd adminbucket && npm run lint:fix && npx prettier --write 'src/**/*.{ts,html,css,scss}'
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.build:backend: cd adminbucket/nginx-1.4.1 && (make || echo 'Backend build skipped - make not available on this platform')
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd adminbucket && npm install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.ci:test: npm run lint && npm run test:coverage
